identitySignals: The name 'California Airways' matches a flight school in Hayward, CA. The City of Hayward's Hayward Executive Airport flight-training page lists it, and the agenda gives Hayward, CA.

Its aviation focus is plausible for a workplace-training partner in OUSD's Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) program. I found no page that links California Airways to OUSD or that program.
research.notes: Not publishable: the match to OUSD is unconfirmed. I hit the tool limit before I could read the organization's own website or any registry page. Search snippets suggest California Airways, LLC (California entity no. 201822110052, per city-data.com), but I could not fetch or verify that, so the entity number and legal name are left null. The website is probably california-airways.com, but I could not fetch it, so it is also null. Sources disagree on the street address: 22693 Hesperian Blvd Ste 220 (City of Hayward, for the FAA test center), 19990 Skywest Dr (Groupon and Yelp), and 21927 Skywest Dr (another Yelp listing). Phone (510) 887-7686 appears in search snippets and on the City of Hayward page, but I left phone and address null because of the address conflict and the identity doubt. A reviewer should check the California Secretary of State record and the company's own site, and look for an OUSD link, such as the MOU document.

profile.summary: California Airways is a flight school and flying club based at Hayward Executive Airport in Hayward, California. It offers pilot flight training and also lists FAA computerized testing.
